title: The best short-term rental podcasts, grouped by where you are as a host
summary: 21 short-term rental podcasts grouped by host situation, with latest episode dates checked November 2026 and shows that have wound down.
body_markdown:
**There are dozens of short-term rental podcasts, and most lists give you all of them in one pile. This one is grouped by where you are: just starting, buying property, pricing and revenue, running a management company, or marketing and direct bookings. We checked every show on Apple Podcasts on November 19, 2026 and give the date of its latest episode, and we've marked the shows that have slowed down or stopped, so you don't subscribe to a feed that's gone quiet.**


## Key takeaways


- **Just starting:** Thanks For Visiting and No Vacancy are the most useful for a new or solo host.
- **Buying property:** The Short Term Show (Avery Carl) and Real Estate Rookie (BiggerPockets) cover the investing side.
- **Pricing and data:** Get Paid For Your Pad, STR Data Lab by AirDNA and RevLabs by PriceLabs.
- **Running a management company:** Vacation Rental Success, Alex and Annie, The Vacation Rental Show and Vacation Rental Scale-Up.
- **Wound down:** The Vacation Rental Manager's Podcast with Sarah and T ended in March 2025. Bill Faeth Unfiltered has had one episode since November 2025.

## Where we're coming from


We host in Hawaii, the Smokies and Joshua Tree, and before ProhostAI I spent 6 years at Airbnb as a staff data scientist on the hosting team. We listen to these shows for the same reason you do: the industry changes fast, and the best operators share what's working. We picked shows that are useful to a host, not the ones with the most downloads. We make ProhostAI, and I've been a guest on one show below; that's disclosed at the end.


## How we checked


- Each show is real, with a link to its Apple Podcasts page.
- "Latest episode" is the newest episode on Apple Podcasts as of November 19, 2026.
- **Active** means an episode in the last six weeks. **Slowing** means none in two to six months. **Wound down** means none in six months, or an announced last episode.


## If you're just starting (or hosting one to three units)


**Thanks For Visiting** with Annette Grant and Sarah Karakaian. Practical hosting and hospitality for small and solo hosts: guest experience, cleaning, reviews, design. Long-running and consistent. Latest: episode 578, November 18, 2026. Active.[Apple Podcasts](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/thanks-for-visiting/id1451872835)


**No Vacancy** with Natalie Palmer. Hosting and design for small hosts, with a focus on making a property stand out. Latest: episode 194, mid-November 2026. Active.[Apple Podcasts](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/no-vacancy-the-podcast-with-natalie-palmer/id1620243933)


**Short Term Rental Riches** with Tim Hubbard. Operations and Airbnb policy for small hosts, often in short episodes. Latest: episode 366, mid-November 2026. Active.[Apple Podcasts](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/short-term-rental-riches/id1488518397)


**Hospitable Hosts** from Hospitable. Operations and tools, with host interviews. It's a vendor's show, so expect their product to come up. Latest: mid-November 2026. Active.[Apple Podcasts](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/hospitable-hosts/id1618939095)


## If you're buying property


**The Short Term Show** with Avery Carl. Short-term rental investing: markets, financing, investor interviews. Avery Carl also wrote *Short-Term Rental, Long-Term Wealth* . Latest: November 18, 2026. Active.[Apple Podcasts](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/the-short-term-show/id1576433178)


**Real Estate Rookie** from BiggerPockets, with Ashley Kehr, Tony J. Robinson and Felipe Mejia. Beginner real estate investing across strategies; Tony Robinson brings the short-term rental angle. Latest: November 18, 2026. Active.[Apple Podcasts](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/real-estate-rookie/id1499646507)


**Short Term Rental Secrets** with Michael Sjogren. Investing and scaling a portfolio. Latest: mid-November 2026. Active.[Apple Podcasts](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/short-term-rental-secrets-podcast/id1517624469)


**Vacation Rental Revolution** with Shawn Moore. Investing and building a rental business. Latest: November 18, 2026. Active.[Apple Podcasts](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/vacation-rental-revolution-podcast/id1453589208)


## If you want to get better at pricing and revenue


**Get Paid For Your Pad** with Jasper Ribbers, Eric Moeller and Kaye Putnam. Revenue management, pricing strategy and, lately, AI tools. One of the longest-running shows in the space. Latest: mid-November 2026. Active.[Apple Podcasts](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/get-paid-for-your-pad-airbnb-hosting-vacation-rentals/id901194206)


**STR Data Lab by AirDNA** with Jamie Lane, AirDNA's chief economist. Market data: supply, demand, occupancy and rates, plus operator interviews. The show to hear before you buy in a new market. Latest: episode 206, November 18, 2026. Active.[Apple Podcasts](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/str-data-lab-by-airdna/id1648542434)


**RevLabs by PriceLabs** with Kyle Driskell. Revenue management for larger portfolios. A vendor's show. Latest: November 19, 2026. Active.[Apple Podcasts](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/revlabs-by-pricelabs/id1763201303)


## If you run (or are building) a management company


**Vacation Rental Success** with Heather Bayer. Small and mid-size property managers, with a lot of recent episodes on AI. Latest: episode 690, November 18, 2026. Active.[Apple Podcasts](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/vacation-rental-success/id599200191)


**Alex and Annie: The Real Women of Vacation Rentals** with Alex Husner and Annie Holcombe. Scaling a management company: owners, teams, growth. Latest: November 18, 2026. Active.[Apple Podcasts](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/alex-and-annie-the-real-women-of-vacation-rentals/id1593234030)


**The Vacation Rental Show** with Lynell Gordon, produced by Inhabit. Professional property management. Latest: November 19, 2026. Active.[Apple Podcasts](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/the-vacation-rental-show-how-we-grow/id1671479811)


**Short Term Rental Management** with Luke Carl. The operations side of running rentals for owners. Latest: mid-November 2026. Active.[Apple Podcasts](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/short-term-rental-management/id1664924682)


**Vacation Rental Scale-Up** with Thibault Masson. Industry news and analysis for professional managers. Latest: October 29, 2026. Active.[Apple Podcasts](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/vacation-rental-scale-up/id1752075462)


**VRMA Arrival** , the Vacation Rental Management Association's podcast, with interviews by Alexa Schlosser. Industry interviews and association news. Latest: October 26, 2026. Active.[Apple Podcasts](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/vrma-arrival/id1465395625)


## If you want more direct bookings


**Unlocked by Matt Landau.** Marketing and hospitality for professional managers. Latest: August 12, 2026. Slowing.[Apple Podcasts](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/unlocked-by-matt-landau/id1294051149)


**The Boostly Podcast** with Mark Simpson and Liam Carolan. Direct bookings and marketing. Latest: June 22, 2026. Slowing.[Apple Podcasts](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/the-boostly-podcast/id1244310134)


Both have large back catalogs that are still worth listening to.


## Shows that have wound down


These still appear on many lists. Their archives are useful, but don't expect new episodes:


- **The Vacation Rental Manager's Podcast with Sarah and T** (Sarah Bradford and Tim Cafferty). Ended with episode 180, "The Last Episode," on March 17, 2025.[Apple Podcasts](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/the-vacation-rental-managers-podcast-with-sarah-and-t/id1281840285)
- **Bill Faeth Unfiltered** (formerly STR Unfiltered). One episode since November 2025, on April 16, 2026.[Apple Podcasts](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/bill-faeth-unfiltered/id1632543313)


## What we checked and left off


- **An official Airbnb podcast.** We didn't find one. Shows with "Airbnb" in the name are independent, and at least one says so in its description. For Airbnb's own guidance, use the[Airbnb Resource Center](https://www.airbnb.com/resources/hosting-homes) .
- **A Robuilt podcast.** Rob Abasolo's Robuilt is a YouTube channel, not a podcast. It's on our list of[communities, YouTube channels, books and newsletters](https://prohost.ai/blog/short-term-rental-communities-youtube-books-newsletters) .
- **A dedicated BiggerPockets short-term rental show.** BiggerPockets covers short-term rentals inside its broader shows, which is why Real Estate Rookie is here instead.
- **Shows we couldn't verify.** If we couldn't confirm a show's latest episode on its official page, we left it out rather than guess.


## How to get more out of a podcast


- **Listen at the right time.** Commutes and the drive to a turnover are good; the hour you should be answering guests isn't.
- **Skip episodes that aren't for you.** A show for 100-unit managers will have episodes that don't apply to a one-cabin host, and the reverse.
- **Write down one action per episode.** If you can't name one, that episode was entertainment, which is fine, but don't count it as work.
- **Check claims before you act.** Policy details change. Anything about Airbnb rules, check on Airbnb's own help pages; anything about taxes or permits, check with your city or county.


## A listening plan you can copy


```text
STR PODCAST LISTENING PLAN (pick 3, not 15)


My situation (circle one):
new / 1-3 units | buying | pricing | running a PM company | direct bookings


1 show for my situation:            ______________________
1 data or pricing show:             ______________________
1 show outside my situation:        ______________________


After each episode, write down:
One thing to try this week:       ______________________
Done? (date)                      ______


```


Three shows you act on beat fifteen you skim.


## Keep it running


The shows above will give you more ideas than you have hours. The way to try them is to take routine work off your plate first:[AI messaging](https://prohost.ai/messaging) for guest replies,[cleanings](https://prohost.ai/features/cleanings) scheduled from checkouts,[AI reviews](https://prohost.ai/features/reviews) written on time. What stays with you is the part the podcasts are really about: strategy, pricing decisions, and the guest experience you're building.


## Shows we've been on


We make ProhostAI. I was a guest on **STR Data Lab by AirDNA** , episode 185, "170 Properties, 2 People: The AI-Powered Property Manager," with Jamie Lane, published June 2026 ([AirDNA](https://www.airdna.co/podcast/str-data-lab-episode-185) ). We included STR Data Lab on its own merits; it would be on this list either way.


## FAQ


**What's the best short-term rental podcast for beginners?** Thanks For Visiting, for practical hosting, and Real Estate Rookie if you're also learning to buy.


**What's the best podcast for property managers?** Vacation Rental Success for small and mid-size managers, Alex and Annie for scaling, and VRMA Arrival for industry news.


**Is Get Paid For Your Pad still running?** Yes, with a new episode in mid-November 2026.


**Which podcasts are vendor-run?** Hospitable Hosts (Hospitable), RevLabs (PriceLabs), STR Data Lab (AirDNA) and The Vacation Rental Show (produced by Inhabit). They're still useful; just expect their products to come up.


**How often is this list updated?** We checked every show on November 19, 2026. Check the latest-episode date on Apple Podcasts before you subscribe.


## The takeaway


Pick the group that matches where you are, subscribe to two or three shows, and turn one idea per episode into something you try that week.
